public_note: The English question and response-option wording for this table was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes Estudio 3531 in Spanish only; the three items are not coded in a common direction -- P1 runs 1 = works quite well to 4 = works badly, P2 runs 1 = very dissatisfied to 10 = very satisfied, and P12 is coded 1 = improved, 2 = worsened, 3 = stayed the same, so its codes are not in order of meaning; don't-know and no-answer responses were dropped to missing by the IRW processing script.
